Plot fishery selectivity and maturity

Source: R/7-plot_sel_vs_mat.R
plot_selectivity_vs_maturity.Rd

Overlays terminal-year fishery selectivity-at-age against input maturity-at-age, faceted by species. Useful for debugging SPR-based reference points (the two curves drive spawning-potential ratio).

Usage

plot_selectivity_vs_maturity(
  Rceattle,
  file = NULL,
  model_names = NULL,
  line_col = NULL,
  width = 7,
  height = 6.5,
  species = NULL,
  lwd = 3
)

Arguments

Rceattle

A single fit_mod() object or a list of them (the first is used).

file

Optional file stem; the figure is written to <file>_selectivity_vs_maturity.png if given.

model_names, line_col, lwd

Deprecated base-graphics arguments, retained for back-compatibility and ignored.

width, height

Saved figure size (inches).

species

Species names for the facet labels. Default: model species names.

Value

A ggplot object.
